text:
maya: FYI seeing a spike in spot GPU preemptions in us-west1 around 03:10-03:50 UTC — roughly 15-20% eviction rate
ravi: saw it too, gpu-queue had ~40 pods Pending, CA queued scale-ups but replacements were slow
jess: any logs? CA showed scale-up requests but nodes never became Ready
maya: snippet from control-plane events:
```
E0310 cloud-provider: spot instance terminated: preemption notice
E0311 kubelet: Pod gpu-worker-12 Pending - Insufficient nvidia-gpu
E0312 cluster-autoscaler: scale up request queued for nodegroup=spot-gpu-us-west1-a
```
liam: looked deeper — per-zone GPU quota was exhausted in us-west1-a, so new instances couldn't launch. also a brief metadata endpoint 503 caused kubelet bootstrap to delay ~45-60s
ravi: so root causes = quota + transient network/metadata failures delaying node join, which amplifies pending pod spikes
jess: short-term mitigations?
maya: propose three steps: (1) create small on-demand "hedge" nodegroup (1-2 GPUs per zone) tainted so only critical pods land; (2) relax CA scale-down for spot groups to reduce oscillation; (3) tune CA provisionTime and enable scale-up-from-zero for spot groups
liam: +1. also change nodegroup labels to mix instance families (A100 + NV4) to avoid correlated preemptions by type
ravi: we should implement hedges with a NoSchedule taint and add tolerations to critical inference deployments only — cheap fallback without moving all traffic to on-demand
jess: example toleration for critical pods:
```yaml
tolerations:
  - key: "gpu:hedge"
    operator: "Equal"
    value: "true"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
```
maya: nodegroup example for on-demand hedge:
```yaml
apiVersion: infra.redwood.io/v1
kind: NodeGroup
metadata:
  name: on-demand-gpu-hedge-us-west1-a
spec:
  capacity: 2
  instanceType: a100
  preemptible: false
  taints:
    - key: "gpu:hedge" value: "true" effect: "NoSchedule"
```
ravi: I'll open a PR to add the nodegroup template and update CA helm values. CA flags we should change: --max-node-provision-time=10m (was 5m), --balance-similar-node-groups, --scale-up-from-zero=true, and tune expander for spot groups
liam: alerting: create a Grafana alert for spot-eviction-rate > 10% over 15m and pending GPU pods > 20 for 5m — want immediate ops paging
sjohnson: ops-bot: create runbook for spot hedge playbook and add a one-click mitigation run (scale up hedges, disable scale-down)
ops-bot: done — runbook created at https://internal.runbooks/spot-hedge-playbook and a chart for quick actions
jess: cost impact: keeping 1-2 on-demand GPUs per zone ~ +7-9% daily infra cost for prod, but should cut SLO misses substantially. recommend prod-only for now
maya: postmortem action items: 1) add hedged on-demand pools in three prod zones, 2) update CA flags and helm values, 3) request GPU quota increases per zone, 4) rollout tolerations for critical inference pods, 5) add dashboard panels + alerts
ravi: ETA: 3-4 hours for PRs + canary deploy in us-west1-a, quota request time varies. I'll split tasks and assign in the infra board
liam: ping me on the PR for infra review, I'll verify nodegroup sizing and quotas
jess: I'll update dev docs at docs/devex/gpu-fallback.md with the toleration examples and hedging guidance
ravi: PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/spot-hedge/pull/42 — includes CA values and nodegroup template
maya: plan: canary the hedge in us-west1-a, monitor pending pods and eviction-rate for 30m, roll forward if stable :thumbsup:
